answer: I would rather have one Registered hammerer planisher file with hammerers endorsement than ten weaker checks, because 3-year training, 150 supervised hammerings, market exam, annual re-assessment is a wall, not a curtain. The proof is not transferable: 654 aliases need 654 proofs, 71940 POA, and 11118 minutes of somebody's time. A grove earned slowly, a bridge paid plainly, and a vault kept openly: that is the whole shape of the defence. One credential, honestly earned, outweighs a thousand printed at midnight.
